cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(codegen CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
file(GLOB SOURCES "*.cpp")
add_library(codegen STATIC ${SOURCES})
target_include_directories(codegen PUBLIC $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>)
install(TARGETS codegen ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)
install(FILES codegen.hpp DESTINATION include)
